verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own background automation primitives. Supabase Cron schedules recurring jobs, from every second to once a year, that run SQL or call Edge Functions over HTTP. Database Webhooks fire automatically on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, and Queues provides durable background tasks with guaranteed delivery. The MCP docs also describe guardrails for unattended agent routines. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run reliably, and native agent-driven background automation (unattended routines run in an external agent client, not inside Supabase).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Supabase Cron is a Postgres Module that simplifies scheduling recurring Jobs with cron syntax and monitoring Job runs inside Postgres.
Cron Jobs can be created via SQL or the Integrations -> Cron interface inside the Dashboard, and can run anywhere from every second to once a year
enabling developers to manage Background Tasks with zero configuration.
Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.
Approve in advance only the project-scoped, read-only tools that the routine needs.
